correctness.rationale: In the replacement, the minimum-norm residual is characterized by its Euler jets at 1 (equivalent to the ordinary jets by a triangular change of basis). Gram positivity and the fixed-dimensional Riemann-sum limit give L^(beta+j) A_(j,L) -> a_j. The interpolating rational function with poles -beta-j and zeros 1 through m-1 gives P(1)=C and P(0)=D from its leading term at infinity and its residue at -beta. On interior compacts the remaining powers k^j are summably dominated after geometric decay. For 0<alpha<1, Dirichlet convergence is uniform since every geometric partial sum is bounded by 2/|1-z|. The frozen proof incorrectly multiplied O(L^(j-alpha)) by O(L^-j) to obtain O(L^-1); the corrected bound O(L^-alpha)=o(1) suffices for every fixed alpha>0. For alpha<=0, multiply by z-1 to isolate the endpoint terms; Abel summation bounds the remaining first-difference series by endpoint first differences and total second variation. Each monomial contributes O(L^(-beta-j) sum_(k=1)^L (k+1)^(beta+j-3)), plus endpoint bounds O(L^(-beta-j)+L^-2). All are o(1/L) for beta+j>1; the beta=1,j=0 term has exactly zero differences. At |z|=1, z!=1 the negative-weight oscillation has nonzero constant modulus after scaling; at -1 the positive-weight coefficient has positive alternating sum, and at alpha=0 the reverse triangle inequality gives m^2-m>0. No numerical certificate is needed; the supplied finite diagnostic was inspected, not run. The corrected proof is replayable in repairs/4/RESULT.md. The limits require fixed m, alpha, and positive separation from z=1 for closed-disk estimates.

value.rationale: This resolves a stated off-root boundary-uniformity gap for a canonical repeated-root factor, quantifying the dominant endpoint and sharp decay order.
